CAUSAL:

junction);

(3) णिजन्तः (न्त, न्ता) (=ending in

II The act of causing: V. Cause, pro-
-duction, creation.

CAUSATIVE:
I Causal: q. v.
II Causing
जनयितृ (f. त्री).

 कार्यं करोति;
